description: This file defines a command handler class for creating delinquency buckets within the Fineract project. It processes commands related to delinquency management, delegating the creation operation to the DelinquencyWritePlatformService.

classes.name: CreateDelinquencyBucketCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service class that handles the creation of delinquency buckets upon receiving specific command requests.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the incoming JSON command to create a delinquency bucket by delegating to the write platform service.
